title: Flight Controls — Flap Drive — Higher Rated Torque Limiter Solenoid and Test Standard 6.7

issue.reason: Initial issue of the higher rated torque limiter solenoid and test standard bulletin.

abstract: Installation of the higher rated torque limiter solenoid together with the flap control test standard that separates a limiter slip from a genuine asymmetry, cutting no-fault-found flap events.

sections.planning_reason: Flap system fault messages are the third most frequent technical log entry on the type and about six in ten clear on the ground with no fault found. Recorded data shows the built-in test declaring an asymmetry when the torque limiter slips momentarily during a cold-soaked first extension. Fifty-eight occurrences were confirmed on a sample of forty aircraft in one winter and two led to an unnecessary computer replacement at an outstation. The change raises the limiter setting and gives the test enough information to tell the two signatures apart.
sections.description: The flap drive torque limiter solenoid is replaced by a higher rated item, the drive clamp is repositioned to suit, and the slat flap control computer is loaded with built-in test standard 6.7, which adds a temperature-compensated settling window before an asymmetry is declared.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Extend the flap fully and make the flap system safe. Get access to the drive unit in zone 561 through the trailing edge access panel. Remove the drive solenoid D2750116570759 and install the higher rated item. Reposition the drive clamp D2750008046179 to the dimension given in the accomplishment instructions and install washers AES606871-9E at the limiter mounting. Set the limiter to the new torque value using the calibration head from the tooling set. Repeat on the opposite side in zone 661. Load the built-in test standard LC8C8E906FE into the slat flap control computer through the maintenance port. Do the flap drive system test and confirm no asymmetry is declared during three full cycles. Do the flap position sensor rigging check. Install the access panels and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to aircraft MSN C00001 through C00503 that are pre modification standard. Aircraft delivered from MSN C00506 onward carry both the solenoid and the test standard. Aircraft that already have the higher rated solenoid fitted as a spare replacement need only the loadable part, which is covered by the companion bulletin.
sections.material_note: Kit K2750-1033-01 contains two solenoids, the clamps, the washers and the loadable part media. Lead time is twenty-six weeks. Removed solenoids are returned to the vendor for credit and must not be re-used at the higher setting.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled A-check, or within 30 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
